ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system that plans, simulates, and optimizes mammalian cell culture fed-batch parameters for recombinant protein production.
ideas.problem_statement: Biotechnology & Life Sciences domain optimization problem for bioprocess engineering.
ideas.title: BioAgent CellLine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a genuinely hard engineering problem in bioprocess modeling rather than wrapping a simple API call, impressing judges with rigorous domain logic.

ideas.pitch: An agentic constellation scheduler that dynamically re-targets low-earth orbit imaging satellites when natural disaster anomalies are detected in telemetry streams.
ideas.problem_statement: SpaceTech & Aerospace domain problem regarding autonomous satellite tasking and mission planning.
ideas.title: AeroConstellation Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the SpaceTech track where few teams have aerospace domain expertise, giving a specialized agent architecture a massive competitive advantage.

ideas.pitch: A hierarchical agentic working memory layer that prevents context degradation and catastrophic forgetting during multi-hour complex reasoning tasks.
ideas.problem_statement: AI & Cognitive Systems domain challenge focusing on agent memory architectures and context window management.
ideas.title: Cognitive Memory Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on core agentic cognitive infrastructure—a pain point every technical judge working with LLMs experiences daily.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized fault-tolerance agent network that monitors ROS2 robotic nodes in real time, isolates compromised behaviors, and patches navigation waypoints.
ideas.problem_statement: Robotics & Automation domain challenge regarding robust autonomous navigation and fault recovery.
ideas.title: RoboGuard Swarm Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical robotics simulation with agentic self-healing, demonstrating end-to-end execution that stands out in a crowded room.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous security agent that executes safe, sandboxed multi-step penetration testing playbooks against mock cloud microservices and generates remediation reports.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity domain problem focusing on automated vulnerability assessment and threat mitigation.
ideas.title: CyberRed Teaming Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a high-stakes security workflow with strict guardrails, demonstrating rigorous safety constraints that appeal to technical evaluators.
